name: comic-strip
description: Write a comic strip in the Comic Chat studio format and return a link that opens it, rendered, in the editor.

interface.shortDescription: Cast a 1996 cartoon troupe into a comic strip
interface.longDescription: Writes a comic strip as a validated document and returns a link that opens it, rendered, in the Comic Chat studio. Twenty eight characters with their own faces and poses, eight backdrops, and a validator that catches a name the art does not have before the strip reaches the screen.
